csv_project_name: Consultant for Long-Term Facilities Master Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Chatham (the Town ), through its Town Manager, in accordance with M.G.L. c. 30B, 6, invites competitive proposals from qualified Architectural and Engineering Designers with experience in long term municipal facilities master planning to provide consulting services. The selected consultant will develop a comprehensive 20 25 year facility master plan encompassing the Town s major asset groups, including but not limited to: buildings, roadways, sewer infrastructure, water systems, stormwater structures, landings and piers, sidewalks, and parking facilities (the Plan ).
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Sanitation Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Public Transit Planning, Transportation Planning

title: Consultant for Long-Term Facilities Master Plan
short_description: Consulting services for a 20–25 year municipal facilities master plan in Chatham.
project_scope: Preparation of a comprehensive 20–25 year municipal facilities master plan for the Town of Chatham covering major public asset groups, including buildings, roadways, sewer infrastructure, water systems, stormwater structures, landings and piers, sidewalks, and parking facilities.
services: Consulting services by architectural and engineering designers for long-term municipal facilities master planning; disciplines requested include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, land use planning, planning/master planning, sanitation engineering, structural engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, public transit planning, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- This is primarily a long-term municipal facilities master planning assignment, not a defined structural design project.
- Scope is broad strategic planning across many asset classes rather than focused bridge, roof, stadium, or special structure engineering.
- Structural engineering is listed, but only as one discipline among many planning-related services.
- No specific building, bridge, span, or complex structural intervention is defined.
- The tender aligns more with planning/consulting than sbp's core interest in concrete structural design opportunities.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender documents. The notice concerns preparation of a 20–25 year facilities master plan only, covering buildings, roads, sewer, water, stormwater structures, landings and piers, sidewalks, and parking facilities; no project-specific capital budget is provided.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the tender documents. As this is a planning consultancy for a long-term municipal master plan, no reliable sbp fee estimate can be derived from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Qualified architectural and engineering designers with experience in long-term municipal facilities master planning.
